title: My Favorite Organic Mattress at Essentia Is Discounted Right Now
gist: A WIRED affiliate deal post on Essentia's Fall Sale: 20% off its organic latex mattresses, including the reviewer's favorite, the Tatami model ($3,799 down to $3,039). It explains the GOTS and GOLS organic certifications.

insights.claim: During Essentia's Fall Sale, the Tatami organic mattress is 20% off, down from $3,799 to $3,039, and the discount applies across Essentia's organic latex line.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Premium organic mattresses are being discounted in fall promotions, a minor signal on DTC demand.

insights.claim: The reviewer explains that GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) and GOLS (Global Organic Latex Standard) certifications rely on third parties to verify that the whole supply chain meets organic standards, not just the finished bed.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Third-party certification is a key differentiator in premium DTC bedding.
insights.locator: An organic mattress is typically made

insights.claim: Essentia uses a single semi-firm organic latex layer with no springs or batting, which the reviewer says limits soft spots, dust mites and motion transfer, and a Kevlar fabric wrap as a nontoxic fire retardant.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: These are product details that support its premium pricing.
